title: Entropy Moduli and Support-Sensitive BKM Coercivity for Rank-Deficient Non-Commutative Markov Semigroups
summary: We study entropy--coherence relations near rank-deficient support boundaries in finite-dimensional quantum systems. For block-diagonal reference states, we establish support-sensitive coercivity estimates showing that the entropy cost of cross-boundary coherence acquires a logarithmic enhancement as the population scale approaches the support boundary. Combined with finite-time entropy bounds, these estimates yield conditional entropy--activation bounds with a logarithmic correction factor of order \(e^{-αt}(1+αt)^{-1/2}\) in coherence-dominant regimes.
